import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeHighWindowPencil
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.SumIntersection

/-!
# A divisor-section pencil for high-window syzygies

Let `v` be a rational unit and let `B` be the preceding divisor window for a
current window `A`.  The two sections `1` and `v` give the required pencil when

* `B ⊔ (B - div(v)) = A`, which makes their products span `H^0(A)`; and
* `A ⊓ (A + div(v)) = B`, which identifies their two-term kernel.

The first assertion uses the sum-intersection dimension theorem and hence four
`H^1` vanishings.  The second is pure divisor-section lattice algebra.  The
final theorem feeds both statements into the finite-basis pencil reduction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Scheme

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.functionFieldOverModule

variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]

/-! ## Spanning by the two pencil sections -/

/-- If the two translated preceding divisors have supremum `A`, their section
spaces span the current window. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pencil_decomposition
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (w : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hsup : B ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = A)
    (hB : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K B) 1))
    (hBw : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊓ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊔ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1))
    (x : divisorSections K A ⊤) :
    ∃ z : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (x : X.functionField) =
        (z 0 : X.functionField) + (w : X.functionField) * (z 1 : X.functionField) := by
  let D := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w
  have hmul : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (w : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K (B - D) ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero w) B]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (w : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero w) = w := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
  have hsections : divisorSections K B ⊤ ⊔
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (w : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [hmul, divisorSections_sup K B (B - D) hB hBw hinf hsupH, hsup]
  have hx : (x : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K B ⊤ ⊔
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (w : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) := by
    rw [hsections]
    exact x.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hb
  let z0 : divisorSections K B ⊤ := ⟨a, ha⟩
  let z1 : divisorSections K B ⊤ := ⟨z, hz⟩
  let z' : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤ := fun q => if q = 0 then z0 else z1
  refine ⟨z', ?_⟩
  simpa [z', z0, z1, Scheme.mulLinear_apply] using hab.symm

/-! ## The two-term kernel -/

omit [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
/-- The relation kernel of the two sections `1,w` is generated by the
preceding window when that window is the indicated divisor intersection. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pencil_relation
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (w : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hinf : A ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = B)
    (y : Fin 2 → divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hy : (y 0 : X.functionField) +
      (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0) :
    ∃ z : divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (y 0 : X.functionField) = (w : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∧
      (y 1 : X.functionField) = -(z : X.functionField) := by
  let D := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w
  have hwyA : (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) ∈
      divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    have heq : (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) =
        -(y 0 : X.functionField) := by
      linear_combination hy
    rw [heq]
    exact (divisorSections K A ⊤).neg_mem (y 0).property
  have hmap : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (w : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero w)]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (w : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero w) = w := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
    change divisorSections K (A + D - D) ⊤ = divisorSections K A ⊤
    congr 2
    abel
  have hwyMap : (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (w : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hwyA
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htw⟩ := hwyMap
  have hty : t = (y 1 : X.functionField) := by
    change (w : X.functionField) * t =
      (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) at htw
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero w) htw
  have hyAD : (y 1 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤ := by
    rwa [hty] at ht
  have hyB : (y 1 : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K B ⊤ := by
    have hmem : (y 1 : X.functionField) ∈
        divisorSections K A ⊤ ⊓ divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤ :=
      Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨(y 1).property, hyAD⟩
    rw [divisorSections_inf K A (A + D), hinf] at hmem
    exact hmem
  let z : divisorSections K B ⊤ := ⟨-(y 1 : X.functionField),
    (divisorSections K B ⊤).neg_mem hyB⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (y 0 : X.functionField) = (w : X.functionField) * -(y 1 : X.functionField)
    calc
      (y 0 : X.functionField) =
          -((w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField)) :=
        by linear_combination hy
      _ = (w : X.functionField) * -(y 1 : X.functionField) := by ring
  · simp only [z, neg_neg]

/-! ## Full finite-basis exactness -/

variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]

/-- Divisor-section form of the basepoint-free pencil reduction. -/
theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_divisor_pencil
    (U : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (w : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hone : (1 : X.functionField) ∈ U) (hw : (w : X.functionField) ∈ U)
    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : divisorSections K B ⊤),
      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hsup : B ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = A)
    (hinfEq : A ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = B)
    (hB : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K B) 1))
    (hBw : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊓ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊔ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1)) :
    LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U (divisorSections K A ⊤) b) =
      LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul) := by
  let a : Fin 2 → U := fun q => if q = 0 then ⟨1, hone⟩ else ⟨w, hw⟩
  apply Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_pencil
    U (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul a
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pencil_decomposition
      A B w hsup hB hBw hinf hsupH x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hz
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : (y 0 : X.functionField) +
        (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0 := by
      simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pencil_relation A B w hinfEq y hy'
    exact ⟨z, by simpa [a] using hz0, by simpa [a] using hz1⟩

/-! ## An arbitrary basepoint-free pair -/

/-- Two arbitrary nonzero rational sections span a divisor window when their
translated source divisors have the required supremum. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pair_decomposition
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hsup : (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = A)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0)) 1))
    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (x : divisorSections K A ⊤) :
    ∃ z : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (x : X.functionField) =
        (v0 : X.functionField) * (z 0 : X.functionField) +
          (v1 : X.functionField) * (z 1 : X.functionField) := by
  let D0 := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0
  let D1 := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1
  have hmap0 : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K (B - D0) ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v0) B]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v0 : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v0) = v0 := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
  have hmap1 : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K (B - D1) ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v1) B]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v1 : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v1) = v1 := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
  have hsections :
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [hmap0, hmap1, divisorSections_sup K (B - D0) (B - D1) h0 h1 hinf hsupH,
      hsup]
  have hx : (x : X.functionField) ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) := by
    rw [hsections]
    exact x.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨z1, hz1, rfl⟩ := hb
  let z : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤ := fun q =>
    if q = 0 then ⟨z0, hz0⟩ else ⟨z1, hz1⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  simpa [z, Scheme.mulLinear_apply] using hab.symm

omit [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
private theorem mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem
    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (v : X.functionFieldˣ) (z : X.functionField)
    (hz : (v : X.functionField) * z ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤) :
    z ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v) ⊤ := by
  let D := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v
  have hmap : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v)]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v) = v := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
    change divisorSections K (A + D - D) ⊤ = divisorSections K A ⊤
    congr 2
    abel
  have hzmap : (v : X.functionField) * z ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htz⟩ := hzmap
  have : t = z := by
    change (v : X.functionField) * t = (v : X.functionField) * z at htz
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero v) htz
  rwa [this] at ht

/-- The two-term relation of arbitrary nonzero rational sections is generated
from the intersection of their translated target divisors. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pair_relation
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hinf : (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = B)
    (y : Fin 2 → divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hy : (v0 : X.functionField) * (y 0 : X.functionField) +
      (v1 : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0) :
    ∃ z : divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (y 0 : X.functionField) = (v1 : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∧
      (y 1 : X.functionField) = -(v0 : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) := by
  let z0 : X.functionField := (v1⁻¹ : X.functionFieldˣ) * (y 0 : X.functionField)
  have hv1z : (v1 : X.functionField) * z0 = (y 0 : X.functionField) := by
    simp only [z0, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    field_simp
  have hv0z : (v0 : X.functionField) * z0 = -(y 1 : X.functionField) := by
    simp only [z0, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    have hv1 : (v1 : X.functionField) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero v1
    field_simp
    linear_combination hy
  have hz0 : z0 ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊤ :=
    mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem A v0 z0 (by
      rw [hv0z]
      exact (divisorSections K A ⊤).neg_mem (y 1).property)
  have hz1 : z0 ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) ⊤ :=
    mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem A v1 z0 (by
      rw [hv1z]
      exact (y 0).property)
  have hzB : z0 ∈ divisorSections K B ⊤ := by
    have hz : z0 ∈
        divisorSections K (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊤ ⊓
          divisorSections K (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) ⊤ :=
      Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hz0, hz1⟩
    rw [divisorSections_inf K, hinf] at hz
    exact hz
  refine ⟨⟨z0, hzB⟩, hv1z.symm, ?_⟩
  change (y 1 : X.functionField) = -(v0 : X.functionField) * z0
  linear_combination hv0z

/-- Full finite-basis exactness from an arbitrary basepoint-free divisor pair. -/
theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_divisor_pair
    (U : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hv0 : (v0 : X.functionField) ∈ U) (hv1 : (v1 : X.functionField) ∈ U)
    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : divisorSections K B ⊤),
      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hsup : (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = A)
    (hinfEq : (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = B)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0)) 1))
    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1)) :
    LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U (divisorSections K A ⊤) b) =
      LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul) := by
  let a : Fin 2 → U := fun q => if q = 0 then ⟨v0, hv0⟩ else ⟨v1, hv1⟩
  apply Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_pencil
    U (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul a
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pair_decomposition
      A B v0 v1 hsup h0 h1 hinf hsupH x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hz
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : (v0 : X.functionField) * (y 0 : X.functionField) +
        (v1 : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0 := by
      simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pair_relation
      A B v0 v1 hinfEq y hy'
    exact ⟨z, by simpa [a] using hz0, by simpa [a] using hz1⟩

/-!
# The two-coordinate recurrence in a field window

For `F = fiberWeilDivisor pi` and `u = fiberCoordUnit pi`, the two sections
`1` and `u⁻¹` of `O(F)` generate every sufficiently large window:

`H⁰(O((m + 1)F)) = H⁰(O(mF)) + u⁻¹ H⁰(O(mF))`.

The proof is the divisor-section form of the standard two-chart argument.  The
two shifted divisors are `mF` and `mF - div(u⁻¹)`; their supremum is
`(m + 1)F`, while the degree of their infimum is `(m - 1) deg(F)`.  Thus the
four `H¹` hypotheses needed by `divisorSections_sup` are discharged by the
window ledger as soon as `windowS ≤ m`.

The final pair theorem records the same recurrence through the existing field
theta presentation `thetaSectionPair`.  It is intentionally stated over a
field curve; residue-field specialisations can instantiate it without any
relative nilpotent-base assertion.
-/

/-! ## Small coefficient helpers -/

private lemma coeffAt_nsmul (n : Nat) (D : C.left.CurveDivisor) {x : C.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    coeffAt hx (n • D) = (n : Int) * coeffAt hx D := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, ih, Nat.cast_succ]
      ring

private lemma coeffAt_divOf_inv (v : C.left.functionFieldˣ) {x : C.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹) =
      -coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v) := by
  have h : Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹ +
      Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v = 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.divOf_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one]
  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt hx) h
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at hc
  linarith

/-! ## The two canonical field-window generators -/

/-- The field-window representative of `(t₀, 1)`. -/
noncomputable def thetaCoordinateFstOne
    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
  ⟨1, by
    simpa only [one_smul] using
      (one_mem_divisorSections_top k (fiberWeilDivisor_nonneg pi))⟩

private theorem fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections :
    (((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)) ∈
      divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤ := by
  let v : C.left.functionFieldˣ := u⁻¹
  change (v : C.left.functionField) ∈ divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤
  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff k (Units.ne_zero v)]
  refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
  have hmk : Units.mk0 (v : C.left.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v) = v :=
    Units.ext rfl
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, hmk, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, coeffAt_nsmul,
    fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt pi, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
  have hleft : coeffAt hx
      (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
      max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  norm_num

/-- The field-window representative of `(1, t₁)`: the inverse of the fibre unit. -/
noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndOne
    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
  ⟨((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField),
    fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections (C := C) pi⟩

@[simp]
theorem thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe :
    ((thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe :
    ((thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) =
      ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField) := rfl

noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (m : Nat) : C.left.CurveDivisor :=
  m • F - Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (u⁻¹)

/-! ## Divisor arithmetic behind the recurrence -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- The coefficientwise max/subtraction normalization is nonlinear in the order value.
theorem thetaCoordinate_sup (m : Nat) :
    (m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m = (1 + m) • F := by
  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sup, thetaCoordinateSndDivisor,
    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
  simp only [coeffAt_nsmul, fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
  by_cases hd : coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ 0
  · have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right hd
    simp only [hmax]
    have hcomp : (m : Int) * 0 - -coeffAt hx
        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ (m : Int) * 0 := by
      simpa using hd
    rw [max_eq_left hcomp]
    norm_num
  · have hd' : 0 ≤ coeffAt hx
        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hd)
    have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 =
        coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
      max_eq_left hd'
    simp only [hmax]
    have hcomp : (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
        (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) - -
          coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) := by
      nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg m, hd']
    rw [max_eq_right hcomp]
    push_cast
    ring

theorem thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg (m : Nat) :
    CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
  rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' k,
    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
    deg_divOf k, sub_zero]

private theorem thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (g m : Nat) (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
    (Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.divisorSheaf k (m • F)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊓
          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊔
          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1)) := by
  have hδ : 0 ≤ windowδ pi := windowδ_nonneg pi
  have hS : windowBound pi hpi + 2 * (g : Int) ≤
      ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi :=
    windowS_spec pi hpi g
  have hm' : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) ≤ (m : Int) := by
    exact_mod_cast hm
  have hb0 : windowBound pi hpi ≤ (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
    have hs0 : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
        (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm' hδ
    have := windowBound_le_S_mul pi hpi g
    linarith
  have hb1 : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg]
    exact hb0
  have hsupdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
    rw [thetaCoordinate_sup, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k,
      deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
  have hinfdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
    have hbal := Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_inf_add_deg_sup k (m • F)
      (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg, hsupdeg] at hbal
    push_cast at hbal ⊢
    nlinarith [hbal]
  have hbinf : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [hinfdeg]
    have hm1 : ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi ≤
        ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hm']) hδ
    linarith
  have hbsup : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [hsupdeg]
    have hmono : (m : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
        ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by omega) hδ
    linarith
  exact ⟨(by
      apply windowBound_spec pi hpi _
      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
      exact hb0),
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hb1,
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbinf,
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbsup⟩

/-! ## The field-window span and elementwise recurrence -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
-- Rewriting both principal-divisor images and the dependent lattice supremum is expensive.
theorem thetaCoordinate_window_span (g m : Nat)
    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
    Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
        ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) =
      divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
  have hwin := thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
  have hfst := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k (f := (1 : C.left.functionField))
    one_ne_zero (m • F)
  have hsnd := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k
    (f := ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
    (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) (m • F)
  have hmk1 : Units.mk0 (1 : C.left.functionField) one_ne_zero = 1 :=
    Units.ext rfl
  have hmk : Units.mk0 ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)
      (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) = u⁻¹ := Units.ext rfl
  rw [hfst, hsnd, hmk1, Scheme.divOf_one, sub_zero, hmk]
  calc
    divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤ ⊔
        divisorSections k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ =
      divisorSections k ((m • F) ⊔
        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ :=
      divisorSections_sup k (m • F)
        (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
        hwin.1 hwin.2.1 hwin.2.2.1 hwin.2.2.2
    _ = divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
      rw [thetaCoordinate_sup]

theorem exists_thetaCoordinate_decomposition (g m : Nat)
    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) (h : H(1 + m)) :
    ∃ z₀ z₁ : H m,
      h = thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
          (thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₀ +
        thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
          (thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₁ := by
  have hspan := thetaCoordinate_window_span (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
  have hh : (h : C.left.functionField) ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
          ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact h.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hh
  rcases ha with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Submodule.coe_add, thetaWindowMul_coe, thetaWindowMul_coe,
    thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe, thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe, one_mul]
  simpa only [Scheme.mulLinear_apply, one_mul] using hab.symm

/-! ## The same recurrence through the field theta pair -/

/-- Componentwise multiplication of field theta pairs. -/
noncomputable def thetaSectionPairMul (a b : Nat)
    (x : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ a) ⊤))
    (y : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ b) ⊤)) :
    ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ (a + b)) ⊤) := by
  refine ⟨(x.1.1 * y.1.1, x.1.2 * y.1.2), ?_⟩
  rw [mem_twistSubmodule_iff]
  have hx := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
    (thetaUnit pi ^ a) x.1).mp x.2
  have hy := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
    (thetaUnit pi ^ b) y.1).mp y.2
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, pow_add, Units.val_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]
  ring

theorem thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul (p q : Nat)
    (a : ↥(divisorSections k (p • F) ⊤))
    (m : ↥(divisorSections k (q • F) ⊤)) :
    thetaSectionPair C pi (p + q)
        (thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) p q a m) =
      thetaSectionPairMul (C := C) pi p q
        (thetaSectionPair C pi p a) (thetaSectionPair C pi q m) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_fst C pi p q a m)
  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_snd C pi p q a m)

@[simp]
theorem thetaSectionPair_add (n : Nat)
    (a b : ↥(divisorSections k (n • F) ⊤)) :
    thetaSectionPair C pi n (a + b) =
      thetaSectionPair C pi n a + thetaSectionPair C pi n b := by
  simp [thetaSectionPair]

   343	class-comparison shift units.  Its divisor is exactly the transported-window
   344	discrepancy `T(M+s) − (N + S)` (`divOf_msCoherenceUnit`), and it realizes the `Φ`
   345	product defect (`divFamPhi_one_tmul_mul`). -/

   347	  thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g)
   348	    * thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)

   352	`div (u_s·u_M·u_{M+s}⁻¹) = T(M+s) − (N + S)` — the theta-divisor terms cancel by the
   353	exponent additivity `thetaFieldDivisor_add`. -/

   356	        - (windowN C K hπ g + windowS C K hπ g)

   366	      (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g))⁻¹
   367	    rw [mul_inv_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one] at h0

     9	/-!
    10	# The finite Koszul boundary for a multiplication window
    11	
    12	Let `b : ι → U` be a finite multiplier basis.  If `L` is a preceding
    13	window and multiplication by `b i` sends `L` into the current window `T`,
    14	then a pair-indexed family `z : ι × ι → L` gives the usual row-minus-column
    15	relation
    16	
    17	`κ(z)_i = ∑ j, b_j z_(i,j) - b_j z_(j,i)`.
    18	
    19	The construction below is deliberately generic.  Its image is visibly killed
    20	by the finite component multiplication map; the converse inclusion is the
    21	actual high-window/Gotzmann syzygy theorem and is recorded at the end of this
    22	file as the remaining interface.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u v
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	/-! ## A generic rows-minus-columns boundary -/
    34	
    35	variable {R L M N : Type u} [CommRing R]
    36	variable [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
    37	variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    38	variable [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    39	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    40	
    41	/-- The alternating rows-minus-columns boundary attached to a family of
    42	`R`-linear maps `step i : L → M`.
    43	
    44	The two occurrences of `step` have the same multiplier index, while the
    45	outer index is the row of the resulting finite product.  This is the finite
    46	Koszul boundary used for multiplication syzygies.
    47	-/
    48	noncomputable def finiteKoszulBoundary (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
    49	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[R] (ι → M) := by
    50	  classical
    51	  refine
    52	    { toFun := fun z i =>
    53	        ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i)))
    54	      map_add' := ?_
    55	      map_smul' := ?_ }
    56	  · intro x y
    57	    funext i
    58	    change
    59	      (∑ j, (step j ((x + y) (i, j)) - step j ((x + y) (j, i)))) =
    60	        (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i)))) +
    61	          ∑ j, (step j (y (i, j)) - step j (y (j, i)))
    62	    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    63	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    64	    intro j hj
    65	    simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add]
    66	    abel
    67	  · intro r x
    68	    funext i
    69	    change
    70	      (∑ j, (step j ((r • x) (i, j)) - step j ((r • x) (j, i)))) =
    71	        r • (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i))))
    72	    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    73	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    74	    intro j hj
    75	    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_sub]
    76	
    77	@[simp]
    78	theorem finiteKoszulBoundary_apply (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    79	    (z : ι × ι → L) (i : ι) :
    80	    finiteKoszulBoundary step z i =
    81	      ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i))) := rfl
    82	
    83	/-! ## Composition with a finite component sum -/
    84	
    85	/-- The component sum kills the rows-minus-columns boundary whenever the
    86	component maps commute pairwise.  This is the substantive finite-stage
    87	syzygy direction (`range ≤ kernel`).
    88	-/
    89	theorem finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
    90	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    91	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
    92	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
    93	    (finiteComponentSum row).comp (finiteKoszulBoundary step) = 0 := by
    94	  classical
    95	  apply LinearMap.ext
    96	  intro z
    97	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, finiteComponentSum, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    98	    LinearMap.proj_apply, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
    99	  simp_rw [map_sum, map_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   100	  change
   101	    (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j)))) -
   102	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i))) = 0
   103	  have hswap :
   104	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   105	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   106	    calc
   107	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   108	          ∑ i, ∑ j, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   109	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	        intro i hi
   111	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	        intro j hj
   113	        exact hcomm i j (z (j, i))
   114	      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   115	        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   116	      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   117	        rfl
   118	  rw [hswap, sub_self]
   119	
   120	/-- Range form of the preceding composition identity. -/
   121	theorem range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum
   122	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
   123	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
   124	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
   125	    LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) ≤
   126	      LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) := by
   127	  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   128	  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
   129	  have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
   130	    (finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero row step hcomm) z
   131	  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using hz
   132	
   133	/-! ## Scalar extension of the boundary -/
   134	
   135	section BaseChange
   136	
   137	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
   138	
   139	/-- Scalar extension of the finite Koszul boundary commutes with the canonical
   140	finite-product tensor equivalences.  This is the bridge that identifies the
   141	base-changed relative boundary with the boundary formed directly in a fibre.
   142	-/
   143	theorem piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   144	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   145	    (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   146	        (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step)) =
   147	      (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))).comp
   148	        (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)) := by
   149	  classical
   150	  apply LinearMap.ext
   151	  intro x
   152	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   153	  | zero => simp
   154	  | add x y hx hy =>
   155	      simpa only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_apply] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
   156	  | tmul a z =>
   157	      ext i
   158	      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
   159	        TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
   160	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
   161	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   162	      intro j hj
   163	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
   164	
   165	/-- After transporting the target finite product, the range of the
   166	base-changed boundary is exactly the range of the fibrewise boundary. -/
   167	theorem range_piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   168	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   169	    LinearMap.range
   170	        ((TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   171	          (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) =
   172	      LinearMap.range
   173	        (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))) := by
   174	  classical
   175	  rw [piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary]
   176	  apply le_antisymm
   177	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   178	    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
   179	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   180	    let e := TensorProduct.piRight R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)
   181	    refine ⟨e.symm z, ?_⟩
   182	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
   183	    have he : TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L) (e.symm z) = z := by
   184	      change e (e.symm z) = z
   185	      exact e.apply_symm_apply z
   186	    rw [he]
   187	
   188	end BaseChange
   189	
   190	/-! ## A finite-dimensional equality criterion -/
   191	
   192	section Finrank
   193	
   194	variable {k₀ A V W : Type u} [Field k₀]
   195	variable [AddCommGroup A] [Module k₀ A]
   196	variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module k₀ V] [FiniteDimensional k₀ V]
   197	variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module k₀ W]
   198	
   199	/-- Over a field, the easy inclusion `range κ ≤ ker μ` is an equality as soon
   200	as the Koszul range has at least the dimension of the multiplication kernel.
   201	Thus the reverse syzygy theorem is reduced to its genuine Gotzmann rank input.
   202	-/
   203	theorem ker_finiteComponentSum_eq_range_finiteKoszulBoundary_of_finrank_le
   204	    (row : ι → V →ₗ[k₀] W) (step : ι → A →ₗ[k₀] V)
   205	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : A),
   206	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z))
   207	    (hfin : Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row)) ≤
   208	      Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) :
   209	    LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) =
   210	      LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) := by
   211	  symm
   212	  exact Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
   213	    (range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum row step hcomm) hfin
   214	
   215	end Finrank
   216	
   217	/-! ## The multiplication-window specialization -/
   218	
   219	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
   220	
   221	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
   222	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   223	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
   224	
   225	/-- Multiplication by the `i`-th multiplier basis vector, corestricted to the
   226	current window `T`.  The hypothesis records the only geometric input needed
   227	to form this map.
   228	-/
   229	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulStepTo
   230	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   231	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   232	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   233	    (i : ι) : L →ₗ[K] T :=
   234	  ((Scheme.mulLinear K (b i : X.functionField)).comp L.subtype).codRestrict T
   235	    (fun z => by
   236	      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
   237	        Scheme.mulLinear_apply] using hmul i z)
   238	
   239	omit [Fintype ι] in
   240	@[simp]
   241	theorem Scheme.finiteMulStepTo_apply
   242	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   243	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   244	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   245	    (i : ι) (z : L) :
   246	    ((Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i z : T) : X.functionField) =
   247	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) := by
   248	  rfl
   249	
   250	/-- The finite Koszul boundary for the multiplication window `U · L ⊆ T`. -/
   251	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary
   252	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   253	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   254	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   255	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[K] (ι → T) :=
   256	  finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i)
   257	
   258	/-- The finite product map kills the multiplication Koszul boundary. -/
   259	theorem Scheme.finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   260	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   261	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   262	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   263	    (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b).comp
   264	        (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) = 0 := by
   265	  apply finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   266	  intro i j z
   267	  change
   268	    (b i : X.functionField) *
   269	          ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   270	      (b j : X.functionField) *
   271	          ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))
   272	  ring
   273	
   274	/-- Range form of `finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero`. -/
   275	theorem Scheme.range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteMulMap
   276	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   277	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   278	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   279	    LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) ≤
   280	      LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b) := by
   281	  exact range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum
   282	    (row := fun i =>
   283	      (Scheme.mulLinear K (b i : X.functionField)).comp T.subtype)
   284	    (step := fun i => Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i) (by
   285	      intro i j z
   286	      change
   287	        (b i : X.functionField) *
   288	              ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   289	          (b j : X.functionField) *
   290	              ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))
   291	      ring)
   292	
   293	/-- A finite-dimensional rank lower bound upgrades the multiplication
   294	Koszul inclusion to the exact kernel presentation.  This is the direct
   295	consumer interface for a fieldwise Gotzmann dimension calculation. -/
   296	theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_finrank_le
   297	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   298	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   299	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   300	    [FiniteDimensional K T]
   301	    (hfin : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b)) ≤
   302	      Module.finrank K
   303	        (LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul))) :
   304	    LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b) =
   305	      LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) := by
   306	  symm
   307	  exact Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
   308	    (Scheme.range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteMulMap U L T b hmul) hfin
   309	
   310	/-- The same composition identity after corestricting the product map to a
   311	specified multiplication span. -/
   312	theorem Scheme.finiteMulMapTo_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   313	    (U L T W : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   314	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   315	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   316	    (hW : Scheme.mulSpan K U T = W) :
   317	    (Scheme.finiteMulMapTo U T W b hW).comp
   318	        (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) = 0 := by
   319	  apply LinearMap.ext
   320	  intro z
   321	  apply Subtype.ext
   322	  have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
   323	    (Scheme.finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   324	      U L T b hmul) z
   325	  simpa only [Scheme.finiteMulMapTo, LinearMap.comp_apply,
   326	    LinearMap.codRestrict_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero] using hz
   327	
   328	/-! ## The remaining high-window input
   329	
   330	The following equality is intentionally left as the next theorem to prove.
   331	It is the missing Gotzmann/syzygy statement that a
   332	future high-window proof must establish (after any residue-field base change):
   333	
   334	```
   335	LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b) =
   336	  LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul)
   337	```
   338	
   339	For the universal high windows, the required fibrewise form is the reverse
   340	inclusion for the corresponding residue-field maps: every kernel vector of
   341	the multiplication map in degree `n` must be generated by these
   342	rows-minus-columns relations from degree `n - 1`.  The results above supply
   343	the other inclusion uniformly and are the finite-stage flatness brick used by
   344	the later Gotzmann argument.
   345	-/
   346	
   347	end AlgebraicGeometry

   186	theorem divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelation_read_mem_stageOneIdeal

   189	    (hx : x ∈ divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)

   209	/-- The concrete kernel hypothesis for the fixed stage-one chart ideal. -/

   228	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1200000 in
   229	-- The chart quotient combines the stabilized reading ideal with direct-limit flatness.
   230	/-- Concrete chart form: after stage-one shifting, only bounded-stage flatness
   231	and eventual saturation remain in the colimit flatness criterion. -/
   232	theorem flat_shifted_highWindow_chart_quotient_of_saturation
   233	    (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) (side : Bool)
   234	    (hsaturation : ∀ n (x : G(n + 1)),
   235	      divUniversalHighWindowChartRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
   236	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) side x ∈
   237	        divUniversalHighWindowRelationReadIdeal (C := C) (pi := pi)
   238	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 1 side →
   239	      ∃ m : Nat, ∃ h : n ≤ m,
   240	        divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelationTransitionOfLE
   241	          (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side n m h x ∈
   242	        divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
   243	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (m + 1))
   244	    [∀ n, Module.Flat RZ
   245	      ((G(n + 1)) ⧸ divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
   246	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1))] :

   249	        divUniversalHighWindowRelationReadIdeal (C := C) (pi := pi)

   252	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j side
   253	    (read := fun n => divUniversalHighWindowChartRead (C := C) (pi := pi)
   254	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1) side)
   255	    (J := divUniversalHighWindowRelationReadIdeal (C := C) (pi := pi)
   256	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j 1 side)
   257	    (hreadK := fun n => divUniversalHighWindowShiftedRelation_read_ker_stageOneIdeal

    10	/-!
    11	# The relative flatness gate for high-window relations
    12	
    13	The recursively generated high-window relation modules are finite, but finiteness and
    14	fieldwise persistence do not by themselves make their quotients flat over the possibly
    15	nonreduced carve-chart ring.  This file isolates the exact extra input needed by the
    16	landed flattening criterion: a finite syzygy submodule whose image generates the full
    17	kernel of the multiplication presentation after tensoring with every residue field.
    18	
    19	With that input, the successor quotient is flat; over the Noetherian carve-chart ring it
    20	is therefore finite projective.  The first two recursive quotients are already projective
    21	and flat, because the carve equations identify them with the two Grassmannian windows.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8
    27	set_option maxRecDepth 8000
    28	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
    29

    43	section HighWindowRelationFlat

    45	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    46	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    47	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    48	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]
    49	
    50	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftHighWindowRelationFlat :
    51	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    52	
    53	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    56	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
    57	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
    58	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    59	variable (g r1 r2 : Nat)
    60	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
    61	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
    62	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
    63	  ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k ((windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    64	    + (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)) ⊤))
    65	variable (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    66	
    67	local notation "RZ" => DivCarveChartRing k
    68	  (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    69	  (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j

    71	/-- The quotient by the recursively generated relation module at a high window. -/
    72	abbrev divUniversalHighWindowRelationQuotient (n : Nat) : Type u :=
    73	  divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
    74	      (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n ⧸
    75	    divUniversalHighWindowRelation (C := C) (pi := pi)
    76	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n

    78	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    79	-- The fully expanded high-window source and fibre kernel exceed the default elaboration budget.
    80	/-- The precise relative persistence condition on a proposed syzygy module for one
    81	successor multiplication presentation. -/
    82	def DivUniversalHighWindowSyzygySpans (n : Nat)
    83	    (K : Submodule RZ
    84	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
    85	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
    86	    (L : Submodule RZ
    87	      (DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
    88	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K)) : Prop :=
    89	  L ≤ LinearMap.ker
    90	      (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
    91	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) ∧
    92	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum RZ,
    93	      LinearMap.ker
    94	          ((divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
    95	            hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≤
    96	        LinearMap.range (L.subtype.rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField)
    97

    99	-- The dependent high-window multiplication presentation exceeds the default elaboration budget.
   100	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   101	-- Synthesizing finiteness and flatness through the dependent source needs additional search time.
   102	/-- A successor high-window quotient is flat once a finite relative syzygy module
   103	generates the complete kernel on every residue-field fibre. -/
   104	theorem flat_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpanQuotient_of_syzygies (n : Nat)
   105	    (K : Submodule RZ
   106	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   107	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   108	    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K]
   109	    (L : Submodule RZ
   110	      (DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
   111	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K))
   112	    (hL : DivUniversalHighWindowSyzygySpans (C := C) (pi := pi)
   113	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K L) :
   114	    Module.Flat RZ
   115	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   116	          (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) ⧸
   117	        divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
   118	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
   119	  letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowMulSource
   120	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K
   121	  letI := finite_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient
   122	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)
   123	  letI := flat_divUniversalHighWindowAmbient
   124	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)
   125	  exact Module.Flat.quotient_range_of_forall_ker_rTensor_residueField_le
   126	    (divUniversalHighWindowMulMap (C := C) (pi := pi)
   127	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) L hL.1 hL.2

   129	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   130	-- The dependent high-window quotient type exceeds the default elaboration budget.
   131	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   132	-- Projectivity synthesis unfolds the finite-presentation instances for this quotient.
   133	/-- Over the Noetherian carve-chart ring, the flat successor quotient supplied by the
   134	syzygy criterion is finite projective. -/
   135	theorem projective_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpanQuotient_of_syzygies (n : Nat)
   136	    (K : Submodule RZ
   137	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   138	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) n))
   139	    [Module.Finite RZ ↥K]
   140	    (L : Submodule RZ
   141	      (DivUniversalHighWindowMulSource (C := C) (pi := pi)
   142	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K))
   143	    (hL : DivUniversalHighWindowSyzygySpans (C := C) (pi := pi)
   144	      hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K L) :
   145	    Module.Projective RZ
   146	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   147	          (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) ⧸
   148	        divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
   149	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
   150	  letI := flat_divUniversalHighWindowMulSpanQuotient_of_syzygies
   151	    (C := C) (pi := pi) hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K L hL
   152	  letI : Module.Finite RZ
   153	      (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   154	          (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) ⧸
   155	        divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
   156	          hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K) := by
   157	    infer_instance
   158	  letI := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite RZ
   159	    (divUniversalHighWindowAmbient (C := C) (pi := pi) (hpi := hpi) (g := g)
   160	        (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) (i := i) (j := j) (n + 1) ⧸
   161	      divUniversalHighWindowMulSpan (C := C) (pi := pi)
   162	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j n K)
   163	  exact Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation

   195	        hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j (n + 1)) L hL
